_notes: Manual curl reference for testing this API locally. Base URL assumes the app is running with default settings (mvn spring-boot:run) on port 8080 with context-path /api/v1. Replace <PLACEHOLDER> values before running. Add a new entry here every time a new endpoint is built.
_verified: auth_google_login and auth_refresh confirmed working end-to-end 2026-09-19 against a real Google account and the Neon dev branch (see PROJECT_PLAN.md Implementation Status).

requests.name: health
requests.description: Actuator health check — should always be public, no auth needed.

requests.name: auth_google_login
requests.description: Google Sign-In. First call for a Google account creates a row in `accounts`. Requires a real Google ID token (aud must match GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS the app was started with).

requests.name: auth_google_login_bogus
requests.description: Sanity check with a garbage token — expect 401 UNAUTHORIZED, not a crash.

requests.name: auth_refresh
requests.description: Exchange a refresh token (from auth_google_login's response) for a new access token.

requests.name: auth_logout
requests.description: Revoke a refresh token. Expect 204 No Content on success.

requests.name: protected_path_unauthenticated
requests.description: Any endpoint outside the public allowlist (/auth/**, /docs/**, /api-docs/**, /actuator/health), called with no Bearer token — expect 401.
